== Notes ==
* If it is used to interrupt a spell on an already-dazed target, dazed will not be reapplied.
* This skill will inflict daze on a foe casting a spell even if that foe is using a skill that prevents interruption (i.e [[Mantra of Concentration]]).
{{bug|This skill does not interrupt spells; the application of daze does: if the daze is not applied (i.e. if the target is enchanted by [[Infuse Condition]] and has a minion to transfer the daze to), no interrupt will occur.}}

== Trivia ==
* This skill has the shortest recharge time of all skills that can inflict dazed (including elite skills, but excluding [[List of adrenal skills|adrenal skills]]). 
* This skill was named "Tongue Biter" during the [[Prophecies]] beta<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20041030000940/http://www.gamespot.com/pc/rpg/guildwars/preview_6111324.html</ref>.
